title: Translon Consensus Pipeline Parameters
description: Parameter schema for the translon consensus pipeline

bed_results_dir.description: Path to directory containing BED12 results organized by tool (e.g., results/*/sample.bed12). BED files must be in proper BED12 format with one entry per translon. Use conversion scripts in scripts/ directory to convert tool-specific formats.

consensus_bed_results_dir.description: Optional path to a tool/sample tree used only for BED12 standardisation and consensus reporting. If omitted, bed_results_dir is used for both Translon DB ingest and consensus.

gencode_gtf.description: Path to gencode GTF annotation file for adding RNA biotype and CDS context. Can be gzipped (.gtf.gz). If not provided, features will not have biotype/CDS annotations.

build_translon_db.description: Build a Translon SQLite database and sidecar TSV tables from all supported caller outputs under bed_results_dir.

ucsc_session_url.description: UCSC Genome Browser session URL (without position) for generating genome browser links in reports

ftp_dir.description: Optional FTP directory path for moving the HTML report. If not provided, report will only be saved locally.
